layers.approved: 2026-11-18 by the owner, from the story art preview
layers.prompt: Backdrop layer for a layered paper-theatre story diorama. Keep exactly the hand-painted paper look, aged cardstock texture, palette and the blue-and-gold marble hall of the reference, flat front view, filling the entire image. Change it into the climb to the throne room: two winding marble staircases spiral up the left and right sides of the hall to a high gallery; along the gallery a row of arched niches, each holding an empty golden crown on a small blue cushion; tall arched windows at the back with no light behind them, a cracked marble floor with a long blue carpet across the lower 35%, no throne. No characters, text, frame, border or vignette; even neutral lighting.
layers.postprocessing: Already 1536x1024 (the backdrop size): no crop or resize; tools/encode.py (WebP quality 80).
layers.seedNote: the GPT image endpoint takes no seed; the raw render is the archive
